Alia Bhatt's film 'Alpha' shows mixed box office performance

Alia Bhatt's film 'Alpha' has experienced a mixed performance at the box office. While reports indicate struggles on Day 5 domestically, the film has reportedly shown strength in overseas collections, particularly on Tuesday. The film's earnings are being closely watched.
